Plot prior and posterior distributions

Source: R/checks.R
plot_prior_posterior.Rd

Plot prior and posterior distributions

Usage

plot_prior_posterior(
  ibmfit,
  prior_fit = NULL,
  parameters = NULL,
  n_samples = 1000,
  ...
)

Arguments

ibmfit

A posterior ibmfit.

prior_fit

Optional prior-only fit from sample_prior(). When omitted, a prior fit is sampled automatically.

parameters

Hyperparameters to display. The default shows an observation scale/shape parameter when present and the model's global smoothing scale (tau or gamma).

n_samples

Maximum draws from each distribution.

...

Arguments passed to sample_prior() when prior_fit is omitted.

Value

A faceted ggplot object.
